stem: How did the publication of Upton Sinclair's The Jungle contribute to a change in the relationship between government and business?

options.label: F
options.text: Federal troops were mobilized to break strikes by labor unions.

options.label: G
options.text: Government regulations requiring the inspection of food products were implemented.

options.label: H
options.text: Congress created a regulatory agency to audit railroads.

options.label: J
options.text: Laws were enacted that banned private companies from discriminating when hiring.
